capabilities: Sync vault files and attachments in the background to a Nodra account
Sign in through the browser with email or GitHub without the plugin seeing the password
Encrypt notes on-device, with a Managed mode (recoverable) or Private mode (end-to-end)
Detect and pause when another sync tool such as Obsidian Sync, iCloud or Syncthing is active on the folder
Manage devices, create vaults, and recover access from a sidebar panel
extras: Free plan: 1 vault, 500 MB, 2 plugin installs, 7 days of version history; payments via Paddle happen on the website. Desktop only (no mobile yet). The repo is an export from a private monorepo; the server side is not open source, though the plugin source is MIT and a SHA-256 check for main.js is documented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault across devices with on-device encryption, browser access, and safeguards against running a second sync tool on the same folder.

requires.name: Pro or Max plan for more storage, vaults and history

summary: Sync service that syncs an encrypted vault to a Nodra account, with Private mode for end-to-end encryption and browser access to notes.
